title: DRE: An Effective Dual-Refined Method for Integrating Small and Large Language Models in Open-Domain Dialogue Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and mitigating the inherent bias of Small Language Models (SLMs) toward positive responses by testing classification accuracy on datasets containing both positive and adversarial negative responses, using a contrastive learning framework.

Mitigating and addressing the tendency of LLMs to favor their own generated text by employing alternative, independent LLMs for the evaluation phase and utilizing human annotators to revise and score samples.
